summary: Milestone 2026.05.260 had 0 experiment commits in the timing window, making this the thirty-fifth consecutive empty-timing-window retro. Both RTX 3090s were idle at 0% utilization (40C / 49C). The persistent root cause — timing-script look-back not anchored to conductor-state.json activated_at timestamp — remains unresolved across all 35 milestones.
bottlenecks_identified: Timing-script look-back window not anchored to conductor-state.json activated_at timestamp: root cause of 35 consecutive empty-timing-window retros. The look-back captures only commits in a fixed duration prior to retro invocation; post-activation experiment commits fall outside this window, making every retro report 0 experiments regardless of actual throughput.
No post-activation dispatch verification gate: the retro fires before any experiment has committed results in the new milestone's timing window, giving no data to analyze.

Zero structural change in 35 milestones despite the root cause being diagnosed and documented since at least milestone .250: the infrastructure fix is queued but never allocated a task slot that executes before the retro runs.
improvements_suggested: Fix timing-script look-back to use conductor-state.json activated_at as the start boundary instead of a fixed look-back duration — eliminates the root cause of all 35 empty-window retros in a single mechanical change.
Wire a zero-artifact alarm at 60 minutes post-activation so the operator is alerted before the retro fires with 0 experiments.
Dispatch at least one non-retro experiment in the same conductor session as milestone activation to ensure at least one commit exists in the timing window before the retro fires.

Treat the timing-script fix as a SCOPE REDUCTION priority task per CLAUDE.md 'Scope-Reduction-When-Flagged Discipline' — allocate it as the first task slot in the next milestone roadmap, before any research-breadth experiment.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Fix timing-script look-back to conductor-state.json activated_at timestamp — single mechanical change that eliminates the root cause of 35 consecutive empty-timing-window retros and restores operational visibility into experiment throughput.
Wire zero-artifact alarm at 60 min post-activation — gives operator early warning before the retro fires with 0 experiments, enabling intervention before the milestone window closes.

Activate first non-retro experiment in the same conductor session as milestone activation — ensures at least one commit lands in the timing window, breaking the structural pattern of retros with no data to analyze.
meta_reflection: This is the thirty-fifth consecutive empty-timing-window retro with identical root cause, identical bottlenecks, and identical top-leverage actions. The retro now adds zero new information — its entire content is mechanically derivable from the prior 34. The most valuable meta-insight is that a retro producing no new information is itself a signal: the infrastructure-class fix (timing-script look-back) should preempt all research-breadth exploration in the next milestone, not compete with it as one of 13 tasks.
honest_verdict: complete: thirty-fifth consecutive empty-timing-window retro; 0 experiments in timing scope; both RTX 3090s idle (40C/49C); gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks=null; root cause (timing-script look-back not anchored to activated_at) persists 35 milestones; top action: fix timing-script look-back before next milestone activates
